scenicChapters.title: Passo di Vivione
scenicChapters.narrative: 30 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-benedictine-convent-of-st-john-at.story: From Tubre it runs 358 km to Tubre; allow about 6 h 10 of riding.
